Robot_Alarm.label: Robot Alarm
Robot_Alarm.description: Here lists all items of an alarm reported by the robot.

Entity.label: Entity
Entity.description: Contains the object ID and object instance ID/name, for example: </10320/2>.

Specific_Problem.label: Specific Problem
Specific_Problem.description: Specific Problem of of this alarm.

Alarm_Type.label: Alarm Type
Alarm_Type.description:
The Alarm Type of this alarm,
				2:Communications, 3:Quality of Service (QoS), 4:Processing Error, 
				5:Equipment, 6:Environmental.

Severity.label: Severity
Severity.description: The severity of this alarm. Critical(1), Major(2), Minor(3), Warning(4), Cleared(5).

Sequence_No.label: Sequence No
Sequence_No.description: Sequence No of this alarm, used to detect alarm loss. A 63 bit value with range 0..2^63-1.

Additional_Info.label: Additional Info
Additional_Info.description: The information related to this alarm.
